description: A fictional stylised low-poly video-game prop, a chunky toy-like cartoon 3D game asset (not a real object, no working parts). At the front a cluster of six long round dark grey tubes arranged in a circle around one axis, held together by two flat round discs: an orange disc at the front end, with the six open tube ends and a small orange centre cap showing in its face, and a dark grey disc halfway along. Behind the tubes a fat dark grey cylindrical main housing with stepped collars at its front and a flat rear cap. On top of the housing a matte black carrying handle shaped like a long flat arch running front to back. At the rear a matte black vertical D-shaped handle with a small orange paddle inside its opening. Under the housing a big round matte black drum, about as wide as the housing, its flat round faces facing the front and the rear, with two orange bands round it, one near each flat face; it hangs from the housing by a short dark grey bracket on its top. Bright orange accents: the front disc and centre cap, the two bands round the drum, and the paddle. The prop is the same on both flanks.
proportions: About 1.05 m long, 0.24 m wide and 0.42 m tall. (length : width : height = 4.38 : 1 : 1.75)
sides: the prop is symmetric left to right; both flanks are the same.
